members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Race condition in streamable HTTP client: the session context manager yields the read/write streams before post_writer has started accepting messages, so early writes are dropped. Both PRs fix this identically by importing TaskStatus from anyio.abc and adding a task_status parameter (defaulting to TASK_STATUS_IGNORED) to post_writer, then calling task_status.started(None) to gate the caller until the writer is ready.
